smoke_path: MATCH (a:Smoke {id: $src})-[:SMOKE]->(b)-[:SMOKE]->(c) RETURN c.id AS id LIMIT 10
smoke_edges: MATCH (a:Smoke {id: $src})-[:SMOKE]->(b) RETURN b.id AS id LIMIT 10
smoke_read: MATCH (n:Smoke {id: $id}) RETURN n.version AS version LIMIT 10
nodes: UNWIND $rows AS row MERGE (n {id: row.id}) SET n:Entity, n.key = row.key, n.version = row.version
evidence_node: UNWIND $rows AS row MERGE (n {id: row.id}) SET n:Evidence, n.key = row.key, n.version = row.version, n.sha256 = row.sha256
claim_node: UNWIND $rows AS row MERGE (n {id: row.id}) SET n:Claim, n.key = row.key, n.version = row.version, n.kind = row.kind, n.state = row.state
paths_1: MATCH (n0:Entity {id: $src})<-[:FROM_ENTITY]-(c1:Claim)-[:TO_ENTITY]->(n1:Entity), (c1)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(e1:Evidence) WHERE c1.state = 'committed' AND c1.version = $version AND e1.version = $version RETURN n0.key AS n0, n1.key AS n1, c1.key AS c1, e1.key AS e1 LIMIT 1001
paths_2: MATCH (n0:Entity {id: $src})<-[:FROM_ENTITY]-(c1:Claim)-[:TO_ENTITY]->(n1:Entity)<-[:FROM_ENTITY]-(c2:Claim)-[:TO_ENTITY]->(n2:Entity), (c1)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(e1:Evidence), (c2)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(e2:Evidence) WHERE c1.state = 'committed' AND c1.version = $version AND e1.version = $version AND c2.state = 'committed' AND c2.version = $version AND e2.version = $version RETURN n0.key AS n0, n1.key AS n1, n2.key AS n2, c1.key AS c1, c2.key AS c2, e1.key AS e1, e2.key AS e2 LIMIT 1001
paths_3: MATCH (n0:Entity {id: $src})<-[:FROM_ENTITY]-(c1:Claim)-[:TO_ENTITY]->(n1:Entity)<-[:FROM_ENTITY]-(c2:Claim)-[:TO_ENTITY]->(n2:Entity)<-[:FROM_ENTITY]-(c3:Claim)-[:TO_ENTITY]->(n3:Entity), (c1)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(e1:Evidence), (c2)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(e2:Evidence), (c3)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(e3:Evidence) WHERE c1.state = 'committed' AND c1.version = $version AND e1.version = $version AND c2.state = 'committed' AND c2.version = $version AND e2.version = $version AND c3.state = 'committed' AND c3.version = $version AND e3.version = $version RETURN n0.key AS n0, n1.key AS n1, n2.key AS n2, n3.key AS n3, c1.key AS c1, c2.key AS c2, c3.key AS c3, e1.key AS e1, e2.key AS e2, e3.key AS e3 LIMIT 1001
